subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 6 — Object-Oriented Structural Modeling, Class & Deployment Architecture
moduleDescription: Rigorous investigation of UML 2.5 structural modeling diagrams, the 3-compartment Class Diagram specification (Attributes, Operations, Visibilities, Multiplicities), the Boundary-Control-Entity (BCE) architectural pattern and its 4 communication invariants, structural relationships (Association, Aggregation vs. Composition cascade destruction, Generalization/Specialization), Object Diagrams as temporal instance snapshots at time t0, and physical architecture modeling through Component Diagrams (Ball-and-Socket interface assembly, Ports) and multi-tier Deployment Diagrams (Device Nodes, Execution Environment Nodes [EENs], and Artifacts).
